- **Nate**: Video-game competitor; won multiple CS:GO/video-game tournaments. S25 bored, took turtles out. S26 helping friends reset high scores at international tournament; fun; feels good to use skills to make a difference. S27 won final of a big Valorant tournament last Saturday (5 Nov 2022); best feeling seeing his name as champion; tournaments bring strong emotions; preparing for other tournaments, busy but loving it; grateful to have a job he enjoys every day. S28: game tournament pushed back, so tried cooking homemade coconut ice cream; sprinkles changed color (photo person scooping ice cream into pan). Last game tournament was tough—didn’t make finals—but staying positive, “get ’em next time.” Considering joining a new gaming team after next tourney; has offers, hasn’t decided; big step, ready for shake up. New project: creating gaming content for YouTube; big fan of such videos, hopes to share love of gaming/connect; already watching others’ videos first. Photo desk with computer, headphones, microphone. Hobbies: video games, movies; action/sci-fi/fantasy/classics. Recent favorites: *Inception*, *Cyberpunk 2077*; chilling at home with games/movies to unwind. D23:21 games/movies take him to new worlds, fill emotions, great after a day; admired Joanna’s comfy living room, asked pointers; will try couch, weighted blanket, dimmable lights. Pets: turtles/turtleling 3 yrs, low-maintenance/calm; S12 adopted dog Max, energetic/joy; S19 turtles got new tank; S20 photo two turtles on pond rock, big help; S24 turtles cheer him. S25 loves watching turtles eat fruit—hyped/cute (photo strawberries/turtle); likes holding them (photo person holding small turtle); turtles have distinct personalities—one adventurous, one reserved; bring joy, great companions; liked turtles since boyhood, knows all about them. S26 made lactose-free coconut-milk ice cream yesterday; invited Joanna over; photo bowl of ice cream with spoon. Loves turtles; said turtle resilience inspiring; shared photo turtle on rocks/gravel. D27:35 calls Joanna full of great ideas, will start writing memories down, or at least things his animals like. D27:37 will also start writing favorite memories with Joanna from now on. D28:21 praised Joanna’s sunset photo, asked inspiration. D28:23 nature reminds us to appreciate beauty; moments stay with you; critters make him appreciate life’s little joys; got them a new friend—third turtle (photo three turtles on rock in pond). D28:25 turtles bring joy and peace, best buddies; saw another at pet store, had to get him; tank now big enough for three. D28:27 happy with decision. **Rolling summary — Audrey & Andrew (as of 22 Nov 2023)**

**Profiles**
- **Andrew:** Financial Analyst since 27 Mar 2023; girlfriend. Hobbies: cooking (rookie; wants healthier ideas), hiking, camping, fishing, rock climbing, balcony flowers, ecology books, birdwatching (binoculars/notebook). Adopted German Shepherd puppy Toby on 11 Jul 2023: smart/loyal/active, loves sweaters, hiking buddy. Adopted shelter pup Buddy ~Oct 2023: adjusting to home/Toby; Toby needs time; named Buddy hoping they become buddies. Buddy likes walks/fresh air/new trails; plans to take both on trails. Adopted third dog Scout ~20 Nov 2023: named for adventurous spirit; keeping leashed initially. Has Toby, Buddy, Scout. Plans to take all three to nearby park (not big) for fun/fresh air. Got essentials for Scout: bed, toys, puppy pads, safe haven. Hasn't taken dogs to groomer yet but will soon. Beach trip planned Nov with gf/Toby (and possibly others). Lives in city, misses nature; nearby parks/hikes; nature peaceful/joyful, escape/peace, feels void. Wine tasting with gf weekend before 24 Oct; tried sushi recently; enjoyed; plans California/salmon roll with sauces. On 28 Oct shared photo of himself with his dog hiking; dog looked happy. On 4 Nov: had great weekend; he and gf went on a bike ride and found a cool park outside town; loved getting away from city/nature. Considering getting another dog but unsure; two dogs already a lot. Audrey advised focusing on Toby/Buddy first; Andrew agreed he’ll take good care of current dogs first. Feels he manages dogs in city; will try Audrey’s mental-stimulation ideas. On 22 Nov: feels lucky to have so many furry friends; dogs always there for us.
- **Audrey:** Dogs Pepper, Precious, Panda, white puppy Pixie (adopted 2 Apr 2023). All mutts: Pepper/Panda Lab mixes; Precious/Pixie Chihuahua mixes. Love hikes/fetch/frisbee/playdates/dog park. Hobbies: cooking, gardening, dog training/grooming/agility, recycled-object jewelry (bottle caps/buttons/broken jewelry into one-of-a-kind pieces; sells some, donates portion to animal shelter). Tattoos: dog/sunflower; four dogs on arm (16 Aug); flower wrist (13 Oct). Recycles; usually public transport; interested in biking. Relax spots: Pepper couch, Pixie bed, Precious chair, Panda rug. Personalities: oldest relaxed/wise; second game-ready; third naughty/cuddly; youngest adventurous. On 24 Oct: accident last week playing with pups; arm in cast; one-arm dog care tricky but managing; feeling better daily. Loves sushi; recommends California/salmon roll first, mix sauces/dips; plans order sushi tonight. On 28 Oct: dogs not acting normally; made appointment with animal behaviorist last Wed (25 Oct). Appointment okay/hectic; behaviorist checked them, asked questions, gave tips/routine changes. Using positive reinforcement; work in progress but dogs responding well, seeing progress. Dogs mean everything; devoted to keeping them healthy/happy; shared photo of two dogs running in field with ball. Excited for nature day/hike; can’t wait to make memories and see pups happy hiking. On 4 Nov: loves checking out new parks with four pups; last weekend dogs ran around/fresh air. Recently joined dog owners group to learn better care; meets weekly for tips from other parents and play. Shared photos of group, frisbee, stuffed toys, tennis ball. Advises city dog care tough but doable; keep active, socialize/exercise daily, add mental stimulation: puzzles, training, hide-and-seek. Assures Andrew he doesn’t need more dogs to make Toby/Buddy happy; offers help. Values friendship/support. On 22 Nov: took four dogs to pet salon on 17 Nov; they were excited, tails wagging, took time to calm, looked cute/shiny, well-behaved. Shared groomed photo. Dogs doing great, exploring, meeting new people, feel loved/safe; grateful they’re part of her life/family.

**Key timeline**
- **Mar–May 2023:** 27 Mar intro; Audrey can’t live without dogs. 2 Apr Pixie adopted; Andrew considers dog; Audrey suggests filter sites. 16 Apr Andrew misses nature; Audrey shows dog/sunflower tattoo. 3 May dogs love hikes/fetch/playdates/dog park. 6 May Andrew searches shelters; Audrey advises breed/living space. 11 May Audrey signs pet bonding workshop—positive reinforcement; both agree punishment never proper; Andrew will look into classes.
- **Jun–Jul 2023:** 13 Jun Andrew hooked on rock climbing; plans outdoor weekly; kayaking/maybe bungee; Audrey invites dog-walk trail; he accepts. 26 Jun Audrey wants bigger backyard/doggy agility/toys; both love animals/family. 3 Jul Audrey dog training course; Andrew can’t find dog-friendly rental; Audrey’s all mutts—2 Jack Russell mixes, 2 Chihuahua mixes, 3-yr pack. Cooking: Audrey loves; favorite Chicken Pot Pie (grandma recipe); go-to garlic; favorite garlic dish Roasted Chicken; Mediterranean; will share; Andrew wants healthier ideas. 8 Jul plan dog hike next month. 11 Jul Andrew adopts Toby; Audrey made personalized wooden keychain dog tags engraved names/personalities. 27 Jul Andrew & gf volunteer pet shelter; Audrey never volunteered; four fur babies most important; Andrew recalls childhood pup Max.
- **Aug 2023:** 4 Aug Andrew camping with gf/Toby; Audrey agility twice/week; Toby smart/loyal/hiking buddy; German Shepherd needs outlet; city-dwellers need time/energy/walks. 16 Aug Audrey gets four-dog tattoo; Andrew farm fresh veggies; pets family/joy. 19 Aug Audrey learns dog grooming; tips slow/gently, sensitive ears/paws, patient/positive. 24 Aug Andrew fishing at lake; Audrey remembers mountain lake; grooming essential—daily brushing, baths, nail trims, love; bond takes time.
- **Sep 2023:** 6 Sep Andrew work stress/balance hard; Audrey self-care daily; Andrew morning coffee/lunch walk; Audrey doggy playdate/new dog beds; Andrew still searching dog-friendly place; Audrey encourages. 24 Sep Audrey park incident: Precious pulled hard, leash busted; chased/caught before injury; shared red retractable leash photo. Andrew anxious; Audrey calmed by petting/hugging, speaking calmly, slow walk; bond stronger. Andrew asks bonding advice; Audrey: patience, regular training, time/love, praise successes; obedience/tricks—sit, stay, shake, roll over; walks multiple times/day. Some breeds bond better. Andrew shares balcony flowers; Audrey has small garden/veggie patch, Peruvian Lilies; easy—water/sun. Dogs enjoy garden. Audrey: just her fur babies; dogs make everything better, can’t imagine life without them.
- **Oct 2023:**
  - 1 Oct 7:09pm: Andrew, gf, Toby going to beach next month (Nov); posts sunset over ocean. Audrey excited; can’t wait for upcoming hike with dogs. Both miss nature vs city. Audrey: dog park walks clear mind/find peace; relief like bird flying free. Andrew loves birdwatching; nature freeing/awe-inspiring. Audrey wants birdwatching; Andrew encourages, offers advice, suggests group birdwatching; will bring binoculars/notebook to log birds. Audrey uses guide book, plans to learn common local birds.   - 4 Oct 4:18pm: Audrey took pups to beach over weekend—dogs played/swam in ocean. Andrew shares last beach trip pic; hasn’t been in a while, misses outdoors; hard to find open spaces in city; work-life balance challenging; nature was escape/peace, feels void. Audrey suggests plants at home/weekend park trips. Andrew agrees, will get more plants.
  - 6 Oct 9:41pm: Audrey reminded of knee injury that stopped her walking dogs—tough because dogs bring joy; pic after walking again: two dogs running with ball. Andrew empathizes; dogs remind us to stop and smell roses/appreciate little pleasures. Andrew asks about recycled-object jewelry. Audrey loves making jewelry from recycled bottle caps/buttons/broken jewelry into one-of-a-kind pieces.
  - 13 Oct 4:22pm: Andrew busy; board games with gf/Toby; weekend cozy cafe/new spot with view; great dog park close by. Audrey made cookies/goodies for pup-friendly neighbors. Dog park: Audrey says paradise; dogs love socializing/exercise/running/smelling; Fetch/Frisbee. Andrew’s Toby active, loves sweaters; chased squirrel around tree. Audrey’s dogs hate snow; prefer sunny grass. Both agree dogs bring joy; Audrey can’t imagine life without little family; got flower wrist tattoo; enough

Sam and Evan are friends supporting each other’s health journeys.

- 18 May, 24 May, 6 Jun, 27 Jul, 7 Aug, 13 Aug, 15 Aug, 19 Aug, 27 Aug 2023: Evan returned from Rockies/Jasper trips in new Prius (old broke down; repaired/sold); hiked. Sam’s check-up showed weight concern; friends mocked his weight (27 Jul), prompting change. Evan had heart palpitation scare (6 Jun), cut processed/sugary foods (loves ginger snaps); Sam cut soda/candy, used seltzer/dark chocolate/popcorn/fruit, started gym/healthier diet. Evan met Canadian woman in Canada (7 Aug, “like a movie”), vacationed with new SO (13 Aug). Evan’s son hurt ankle in soccer (15 Aug); Sam’s doctor wake-up led to cooking class/grilled salmon/veg. Evan encouraged slow progress; “Every step matters,” “You’re doing awesome.” Sam tried painting; Evan watercolored for years, started painting classes (19 Aug). Sam’s new diet/exercise routine made huge difference (27 Aug). Bonsai symbolizes strength/resilience.
- 11 Sept 2023: Evan greeted; sunset over water painting. Sam life up-and-down; asked about before/after body photo. Evan: healthier choices made difference; small changes big impact. Sam still craves sugary drinks/snacks; triggers stress/boredom/comfort. Evan: breaking bad habits hard; little victories count; painting/drive helps. Agreed painting/hobby calming. Evan offered help/supplies; planned painting session next Saturday; suggested acrylics, brushes, canvas/paper, palette. Sam accepted.
- 6 Oct 2023: Sam greeted; eating healthier (fruit bowl); asked hobbies. Evan: knee injury from basketball with kids; misses adventures; PT/easy exercises. Sam asked active indoor hobbies. Evan: watercolor; helped lost tourist/city tour. Shared cactus desert painting; paints what’s on mind/feelings—memories/places. Sam loves writing/journaling; therapeutic; drawing cool, still learning. Phone navigation app malfunction; Evan recommended update; encouraged writing. All need outlet.
- 8 Oct 2023: Sam check-up Monday; doctor: weight serious health risk—can worsen. Evan: tough news; health can dampen things. Started lifting weights one year ago.
- Mid/late Oct 2023: additional sessions occurred (details truncated).
- 5 Dec 2023: Evan’s new Prius broke down; stressor for active lifestyle/road trips; trying to see as chance to explore other ways. Sam attended Weight Watchers, learned tips (fruit/yogurt smoothie bowl). Evan praised; considering yoga—gentle, stress/flexibility. Sam: yoga great; done wonders; recommended. Evan will try; Sam offered tips. Support invaluable; not being alone makes difference.
- 9 Dec 2023: Evan’s partner pregnant; excited/nervous; wants to build family memories. Sam congratulated. Evan showed family-memory collage; Banff sign “Bring it on Home”—family motto/togetherness. Family his rock; planning big reunion next summer; Sam offered organizing tips.
- 17 Dec 2023 (session_20): Evan greeted. Sam through bumps. Evan’s son had accident Tues 12 Dec 2023, fell off bike; rough but doing better; photo with crutches/backpack. Sam sorry. Evan asked happy hobbies; Sam used to love hiking but no chance. Evan suggested hike/nature centers. Sam: weight affects confidence/motivation; feels can’t overcome. Evan: believe in yourself one day at a time; worth not defined by weight; step out, try new little things; “You got this!” Sam will try. Evan: accomplishment comes from trying; finished contemporary figurative painting emphasizing emotional state via expressive brushwork/vibrant color; proud; close friend helped get it in exhibition.
- 26 Dec 2023 (session_21): Evan greeted; up/down. Evan got married last week (≈19 Dec 2023) to Canadian woman he met in Canada—love at first sight; shared bride/groom kissing photo. Sam congratulated; asked if she was the woman from Canada; yes. Sam: connection liberating; love powerful. Evan: love amazing like sunset. Sam wishes he could feel same, but started morning runs—clears head. Evan: find what works; keep trying new things; may find love unexpectedly; embrace journey. Evan shared paintings: sad/mad/hopeful emotions; art portrays feelings without words; bird painting joy/freedom. Sam praised; shared exhibit painting that inspired him (woman holding flowers). Evan asked how long Sam painted; Sam sketches occasionally, nothing remarkable yet, feels he’ll show something before long; Evan offered help. Evan loses keys weekly; Sam joked GPS sensor; Evan will do it as soon as he finds it.
- 31 Dec 2023 (session_22): Sam getting into healthier lifestyle; took friends on epic hiking trip last Friday. Evan: fantastic. Took Prius on long drive to mountains last weekend; perfect until minor scrape/accident on way back. Sam asked if okay. Evan: fine; minor accident dampened telling work friends about marriage, but support/thrilled. Evan: whirlwind emotions; reminder take it easy on road. Sam: stay safe; glad enjoy peaceful moments. Evan: nature brings peace/clarity/healing. Sam: nature makes everything small, helps find peace/bigger picture. Evan shared new healthy snacks; will send recipes. Sam asked healthier snack ideas. Evan: trying to eat healthier; discovered energy balls recipe [coconut/oats]; energizing/healthy sweet-tooth satisfaction. Sam will try. Sam says Evan’s help means a lot; reports recurring self-checkout store issues; Evan never had problem; Sam jokes he attracts those situations and invites Evan to call if he ever wants to be in that situation with him at the store.
- 6 Jan 2024 (session_23): Evan told extended family about marriage yesterday—special; overwhelmed by love/support. Evan had heart palpitation scare (6 Jun), cut processed/sugary foods (loves ginger snaps); Sam cut soda/candy, used seltzer/dark chocolate/popcorn/fruit, started gym/healthier diet. Evan met Canadian woman in Canada (7 Aug, “like a movie”), vacationed with new SO (13 Aug). Evan’s son hurt ankle in soccer (15 Aug); Sam’s doctor wake-up led to cooking class/grilled salmon/veg. Evan encouraged slow progress; “Every step matters,” “You’re doing awesome.” Sam tried painting; Evan watercolored for years, started painting classes (19 Aug). Sam’s new diet/exercise routine made huge difference (27 Aug). Bonsai symbolizes strength/resilience.

Sam still craves sugary drinks/snacks; triggers stress/boredom/comfort. Evan: breaking bad habits hard; little victories count; painting/drive helps. Agreed painting/hobby calming. Evan offered help/supplies; planned painting session next Saturday; suggested acrylics, brushes, canvas/paper, palette. Sam accepted.

Sam loves writing/journaling; therapeutic; drawing cool, still learning. Phone navigation app malfunction; Evan recommended update; encouraged writing. All need outlet.
- 8 Oct 2023: Sam check-up Monday; doctor: weight serious health risk—can worsen. Evan: tough news; health can dampen things. Started lifting weights one year ago.
- Mid/late Oct 2023: additional sessions occurred (details truncated).

Sam attended Weight Watchers, learned tips (fruit/yogurt smoothie bowl). Evan praised; considering yoga—gentle, stress/flexibility. Sam: yoga great; done wonders; recommended. Evan will try; Sam offered tips. Support invaluable; not being alone makes difference.
- 9 Dec 2023: Evan’s partner pregnant; excited/nervous; wants to build family memories. Sam congratulated. Evan showed family-memory collage; Banff sign “Bring it on Home”—family motto/togetherness. Family his rock; planning big reunion next summer; Sam offered organizing tips.
- 17 Dec 2023 (session_20): Evan greeted. Sam through bumps. Evan’s son had accident Tues 12 Dec 2023, fell off bike; rough but doing better; photo with crutches/backpack. Sam sorry. Evan asked happy hobbies; Sam used to love hiking but no chance. Evan suggested hike/nature centers. Sam: weight affects confidence/motivation; feels can’t overcome. - 26 Dec 2023 (session_21): Evan greeted; up/down. Evan got married last week (≈19 Dec 2023) to Canadian woman he met in Canada—love at first sight; shared bride/groom kissing photo. Sam congratulated; asked if she was the woman from Canada; yes. Sam: connection liberating; love powerful. Evan: love amazing like sunset. Sam wishes he could feel same, but started morning runs—clears head. Evan: find what works; keep trying new things; may find love unexpectedly; embrace journey. Evan shared paintings: sad/mad/hopeful emotions; art portrays feelings without words; bird painting joy/freedom. Sam praised; shared exhibit painting that inspired him (woman holding flowers). Evan asked how long Sam painted; Sam sketches occasionally, nothing remarkable yet, feels he’ll show something before long; Evan offered help. Evan loses keys weekly; Sam joked GPS sensor; Evan will do it as soon as he finds it.
- 31 Dec 2023 (session_22): Sam getting into healthier lifestyle; took friends on epic hiking trip last Friday. Evan: fantastic. Took Prius on long drive to mountains last weekend; perfect until minor scrape/accident on way back. Sam asked if okay. Evan: fine; minor accident dampened telling work friends about marriage, but support/thrilled. Evan: whirlwind emotions; reminder take it easy on road. Sam: stay safe; glad enjoy peaceful moments. Evan: nature brings peace/clarity/healing. Sam: nature makes everything small, helps find peace/bigger picture. Evan shared new healthy snacks; will send recipes. Sam asked healthier snack ideas. Evan: trying to eat healthier; discovered energy balls recipe [coconut/oats]; energizing/healthy sweet-tooth satisfaction. Sam will try. Sam says Evan’s help means a lot; reports recurring self-checkout store issues; Evan never had problem; Sam jokes he attracts those situations and invites Evan to call if he ever wants to be in that situation with him at the store.
- 6 Jan 2024 (session_23): Evan told extended family about marriage yesterday—special; overwhelmed by love/support. Sam congratulated; family support important; both blessed with amazing families; family his rock. Evan agrees; family is our rock. Sam asks what’s cooking. Evan shares wedding cake photo; weddings special. Sam admires cake; asks upcoming plans. Evan: going to Canada next month (Feb 2024) for honeymoon; excited to create memories, explore snowy landscapes. Sam asks plans. Evan: ski, try local cuisine, enjoy beautiful views. Sam: perfect honeymoon; have incredible time. Evan: will try poutine. Sam: never tried it; Canadian thing; report back details. Evan: will keep him posted; talk soon.
- 10 Jan 2024, 12:17 am (session_24): Evan told Sam something funny/embarrassing: went out with friends, drank too much, had a pee accident near someone’s roses; apologized, people were understanding; out of control, must be careful. Sam: awkward, but humans mess up. Evan: reminder to learn from mistakes; he and partner tried snowshoeing over weekend—new adventure, surprisingly fun. Sam: snowshoeing good active winter option; he made a meal plan/workout schedule, motivated by something, starting today. Evan praised; asked if Sam had doctor advice. Sam hasn’t seen doctor in a while; will make appointment soon; plans to ask about balanced diet and low-impact exercises given his situation. Evan: right direction; focus balanced diet/low-impact; keep him posted; suggested swimming, yoga, walking. Sam liked salad idea from restaurant; watched The Godfather, motivated to keep routine. Sam called it zen; will go for beach walks; bragged about recurring dream flying over skyscrapers. Evan joked a little more and Sam may learn to control those dreams; let him know once he gets the hang of it; enjoy fresh air/views. Sam thanked Evan; will make the most of it; wished Evan a good one.
- 11 Jan 2024, 9:37 pm (session_25): Sam said health issues have been rough; feels weight is keeping him from fully living; trying to stay positive but not easy. Evan sympathized, encouraged self-care. Evan had to apologize to his partner for the drunken night/rose-bush incident; she wasn’t thrilled but understood it was an accident; he promised to be more careful. Sam hasn’t found low-impact exercises he likes, but car rides help him chill/enjoy views; shared photo of country field/fence/dirt road. Evan shared kayak sunset photo from last summer camping—peaceful, unforgettable; nature calms and resets. He also shared a park photo of a pink-flowering tree from last spring when he felt down; vibrant colors brought a smile; reminded Sam to find joy in little things.
